title: Nutritional Knowledge, Awareness and Willingness to Change Protein intake in Patients with Chronic Lung Disease
summary:
This study investigates dietary behavior and nutritional status with regard to the willingness to change diet in chronic lung diseases. Participants will be interviewed and examined regarding their dietary habits and nutritional status. The data will be analyzed quantitatively.
The planned study will contribute to closing existing research gaps in the field of nutrition for patients with chronic lung diseases, particularly with regard to:
- The role of nutritional knowledge, - Awareness and willingness to change in everyday life,
- The role of general health-conscious behavior in dietary behavior,
- The identification of groups for whom nutritional counseling with regard to risk and willingness to change is beneficial.

interventions.name: Patients with chronic lung diseases are asked about nutritional knowledge, awareness and willingness to change protein intake. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Medically confirmed diagnosis of a chronic lung disease
- Sufficient language skills to complete the questionnaires
Exclusion criteria:
- Severe mental health comorbidities that make valid questioning and examination impossible
- Cognitive impairments that make valid questioning and examination impossible
